eyebrow: Americans for Immigrant Justice · 30th Gala shoot, Miami · 26 Aug 2026 · Sound-bite montage
title: Hope Is…
headline: Three AIJ leaders finish the same short sentences about hope, in their own words.
story: On the shoot day, Sui, Paul and Cheryl each answered three prompts: “Hope is…”, “AIJ in one word” and “Where hope meets the law…”. This montage cuts their answers together. The gala theme is hope, and AIJ’s line is “Where hope meets the law”.
Short, warm and music-driven. No politics, no fear, no legal words. Andrés suggested this clip but has not approved it yet. Nick shows him V1.
do: Open on Sui and <q>HOPE IS…</q> on frame 1.
Show each prompt as text, because the interviewer is cut.
Keep each person’s words exact. Never join two people into one sentence.
Keep it 30–40 s. Under 30 s: add Paul C9279 02:41.57–02:57.81. Over 40 s: end Paul’s first line at “immigration status” (01:49.75).
Colour-match the three shoots. The footage is flat log.
dont: No logo, name or black at 0:00.
Don’t open on a one-word answer. Cheryl’s and Paul’s films open that way.
Don’t use Paul’s <q>hope is not passive</q> (C9279 27:22–27:46).
Don’t use Cheryl’s “Hope for me is comprehensive immigration reform…” answers (FX3-3760 00:55–01:25, 02:07–03:55).
No interviewer audio. No second aspect ratio.

brief.title: AIJ 30th Anniversary Gala: Videographer Field Brief (26 Aug)
brief.note: The plan for the 26 Aug shoot day: Sui at Coconut Grove, Cheryl in Coral Gables, Paul at the Brickell office.

reference.title: Selena (Netflix): Sui’s pick
reference.note: Picked by Sui and Andrés. Sui: the music created a lot of drama. Also from them: HBO ↗ (cinematic, artsy, not corporate) and acaciajustice.org ↗ homepage video (intimate tone). Match the pace and the music-driven feel, not the story.

checklist: Frame 1 is Sui’s face with <q>HOPE IS…</q>. No logo, no black.
Every caption matches what each person says, word for word.
The org name on screen is “Americans for Immigrant Justice” in full every time.
Name plates use the same names and titles as the three gala films.
The one-word answers sit in the middle and move fast.
Colour matches across Sui (outdoors), Paul (office) and Cheryl (home).

decisions.b: Andrés wrote “Consider whether to add the ‘one word to describe AIJ’ answer as bites in this clip or as it’s own clip.” He has not said yes to a standalone clip. Nick shows him V1.

client_note: Why this matters: Sui asked for artsy, cinematic and music-driven. A 35-second hope montage is the cleanest test of that look.
